demo.title: moonbag-example.sh
demo.code:
# Buy normally, then immediately sweep the configured moonbag slice to a separate wallet
bankr agent prompt "Buy $500 of TOKEN on Base"
bankr wallet portfolio
bankr agent prompt "Send exactly <moonbag-amount> TOKEN on Base to <moonbag-wallet>"

setup: Login to Bankr: `bankr login email you@example.com`
Default: vault 10% or $50 of each buy, whichever protects more tokens
Normal exits never touch the moonbag; emergency/rug exits require explicit moonbag liquidation intent
